name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 3 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 17 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2025-06-16, at wavelengths from 0.82 to 3.16 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
